ENVIRONMENTAL ACTIVITIES — PREMIUM REVISION PAPER #7
====

GRADE: Grade 2
SUBJECT: ENVIRONMENTAL ACTIVITIES
TIME ALLOWED: 2 hours 30 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 100
EXAM BODY: KPSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. In a food chain, green plants are usually: (1 mark)
   A. Tertiary consumers
   B. Decomposers only
   C. Producers
   D. Primary consumers only

2. An element is: (1 mark)
   A. Any substance that conducts electricity
   B. A mixture of two liquids
   C. Any white crystal used in cooking
   D. A pure substance that cannot be broken down into a simpler substance by chemical means

3. The SI unit of force is the: (1 mark)
   A. newton (N)
   B. watt (W)
   C. pascal (Pa)
   D. joule (J)

4. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Weather its resources? (1 mark)
   A. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Weather its resources.
   B. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Weather its resources.
   C. Skip labelling diagrams related to Weather its resources.
   D. Guess results without recording observations on Weather its resources.

5. Which practice best shows correct science when studying School environment environment? (1 mark)
   A. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about School environment environment.
   B. Skip labelling diagrams related to School environment environment.
   C. Guess results without recording observations on School environment environment.
   D. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for School environment environment.

6. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Forming shadows in light? (1 mark)
   A. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Forming shadows in light.
   B. Guess results without recording observations on Forming shadows in light.
   C. Skip labelling diagrams related to Forming shadows in light.
   D. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Forming shadows in light.

7. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Water its resources? (1 mark)

   A. Skip labelling diagrams related to Soil and its resources.
   B. Guess results without recording observations on Soil and its resources.
   C. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Soil and its resources.
   D. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Soil and its resources.

9. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Recording weather? (1 mark)
   A. Guess results without recording observations on Recording weather.
   B. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Recording weather.
   C. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Recording weather.
   D. Skip labelling diagrams related to Recording weather.

10. Diffusion is best described as: (1 mark)
   A. Movement of water only across a membrane
   B. A chemical reaction forming ash
   C. Net movement of particles from high to low concentration
   D. Heating until a solid melts

11. Why is water unsuitable for a petrol fire? (1 mark)
   A. Water always increases oxygen
   B. Water removes heat too quickly
   C. Petrol fires have no fuel
   D. Water can spread burning petrol instead of putting it out safely

12. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Interpreting? (1 mark)
   A. Guess results without recording observations on Interpreting.
   B. Skip labelling diagrams related to Interpreting.
   C. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Interpreting.
   D. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Interpreting.

13. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Animals resources? (1 mark)
   A. Guess results without recording observations on Animals resources.
   B. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Animals resources.
   C. Skip labelling diagrams related to Animals resources.
   D. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Animals resources.

14. Which change is a physical change? (1 mark)
   A. Paper burning to ash
   B. Milk souring
   C. Ice melting to water
   D. Iron rusting

15. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Safety when handling? (1 mark)
   A. Guess results without recording observations on Safety when handling.
   B. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Safety when handling.
   C. Skip labelling diagrams related to Safety when handling.
   D. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Safety when handling.

16. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Precautions when using? (1 mark)
   A. Skip labelling diagrams related to Precautions when using.
   B. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Precautions when using.
   C. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Precautions when using.
   D. Guess results without recording observations on Precautions when using.

17. Soil erosion is reduced by: (1 mark)
   A. Removing all vegetation
   B. Burning crop residue every week
   C. Overgrazing continuously
   D. Planting cover crops and terracing slopes

18. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Transporting? (1 mark)
   A. Skip labelling diagrams related to Transporting.
   B. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Transporting.
   C. Guess results without recording observations on Transporting.
   D. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Transporting.

19. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Energy: Light its resources? (1 mark)
   A. Guess results without recording observations on Energy: Light its resources.
   B. Skip labelling diagrams related to Energy: Light its resources.
   C. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Energy: Light its resources.
   D. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Energy: Light its resources.

20. Boiling point of pure water at standard pressure is about: (1 mark)
   A. 37 °C
   B. 100 °C
   C. 0 °C
   D. 50 °C

21. A compound differs from a mixture because: (1 mark)
   A. Elements in a compound are chemically combined in a fixed ratio
   B. A compound can be separated by filtering only
   C. A mixture always has a fixed melting point
   D. Mixtures cannot exist in Kenya

22. Photosynthesis mainly produces: (1 mark)
   A. Only water vapour
   B. Nitrogen gas only
   C. Glucose and oxygen
   D. Only carbon dioxide
